_comment: The one place the screenshot pipeline and the App Store Connect uploader agree on what
Kadō publishes: which languages, which device sizes, and which canvas each size needs.
Scripts/screenshots.sh reads it to know what to photograph; Scripts/appstore.py reads it
to know which screenshot set each folder belongs in.
`displayType` is App Store Connect's own name for a screenshot set. Apple folded the 6.9"
iPhone into the 6.7" set rather than adding a size, so a 1320x2868 capture is uploaded as
APP_IPHONE_67 — the name is historical, the canvas is current. If Apple ever splits them,
this is the line that changes and nothing else.
